allow: PowerShell(Get-WinEvent -LogName System -MaxEvents 3000 | Where-Object { $_.TimeCreated -lt [datetime]"2026-04-29 15:40:00" -and $_.TimeCreated -gt [datetime]"2026-04-29 13:00:00" } | Select-Object TimeCreated, Id, Level, ProviderName, @{N='Msg';E={$_.Message.Substring\(0, [Math]::Min\(150, $_.Message.Length\)\)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize)
